name: Dr. Zakir Hussain Parray
qualifications: Ph.D Anaesthesia & Trauma, M.Sc Anaesthesia Operation Theatre Technology, B.Sc OTT, DOTT,NEP-2020, DSA,.....
position: Head Of Department Anaesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology
bio:
Dr. Zakir Hussain Parray is an academic leader, educator, researcher, author, healthcare professional, academic consultant, and entrepreneur working at the intersection of Anaesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology, Allied Health Sciences, medical education, research, academic quality, accreditation, and professional development.    With 8+ years of professional experience, his career has progressed from clinical Operation Theatre practice to higher education, academic leadership, national faculty development, curriculum design, research, academic publishing, accreditation, and professional consulting.
He has worked across clinical and academic environments, including Government Medical College & Hospital, Baramulla; Adesh Institute of Medical Sciences; Rayat Bahra University; Guru Kashi University; Brainware University; and Emversity. His professional journey includes roles as an Operation Theatre Technician, Unit Head, Assistant Professor, Academic Coordinator, Program Coordinator, HOD, Master Trainer, and national-level academic leader.
At the national level, he has been involved in Anaesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology (AOTT) academic leadership, curriculum development, faculty training, competency-based education, institutional quality systems, NAAC documentation, NCAHP-aligned academic frameworks, research supervision, and academic coordination.
